mapper.insert: INSERT INTO local_videos (id, workspace_key, filename, sha256, size_bytes, duration_ms, width, height, video_codec, audio_codec) VALUES (#{video.id}, #{video.workspaceKey}, #{video.filename}, #{video.sha256}, #{video.sizeBytes}, #{video.durationMs}, #{video.width}, #{video.height}, #{video.videoCodec}, #{video.audioCodec,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ON CONFLICT (workspace_key, sha256) DO NOTHING
